METHODOLOGY NOTES — carry these into the published report
Self-reported shift, not a measured delta

The pre-InvokED baseline question was cut to meet the 10-turn cap. Perception shift is what respondents say changed, not a before/after measurement. State this plainly rather than implying a measured change.
Network continuity is a count, not a rate
No single question is now asked of every respondent about staying connected, so a single % would misrepresent the data. Report named connections.

~800–1,000 invited; 150–250 completions expected. Respondents who collaborated are likelier to reply, so collaboration rates skew high. Say so — the honest number is more credible than the flattering one.
